items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Evidence: 27 deployed improvements await measurement, 7 requests failed, 46 failure follow-ups remain open, and only 1 outcome is proven; revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 with $0 site-attributed commission, while AI cost is $963.57 for 2026-09-01–2026-09-26. ROI, margin, causal lift, and cost-to-learn remain unknown. No new change request is justified because the authoritative candidate list is empty and existing capacity is occupied. Owner decision: authorize the prepared Woot permission request after human-counsel review, or keep it unsent.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private. Woot API access is documented, but public/commercial reuse rights and legal, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain incomplete; all four legal checklist tasks are open. Smallest next step: complete the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. External outreach remains unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Recommendation: preserve failed-work containment without requeue. Existing failures must first have canonical lineage, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition. No new production work is accepted this cycle.

Recommendation: continue source-dated measurement and attribution reconciliation only. Do not add instrumentation, request duplicate telemetry, or assign the $4.92 aggregate provider commission to any site. The smallest next step is to complete the existing measurement windows and reconcile attributable outcomes.
